notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Uthros by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least seven {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Uthros.
Repeat.
